item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately amends an earlier executive order by deleting prior administrative text; this is internal executive housekeeping, not a change to private legal rights.","evidence":"is amended by deleting the last phrase"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"The President substitutes an administrative implementation standard into the earlier order, effective as part of the amendment rather than dictating a later agency legal outcome.","evidence":"shall be implemented in accord with Section 3(a) of the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1980"},{"segment_id":"3","code":1,"rationale":"The President reassigns statistical functions from Commerce to OMB, mandates an internal redelegation to the OIRA Administrator, and revokes obsolete administrative provisions; these are internal authority assignments.","evidence":"the Director shall redelegate to the Administrator for the Office of Information and Regulatory Affairs"},{"segment_id":"4","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately substitutes OMB officials for Commerce officials and revokes prior executive-order provisions, reorganizing internal administration without itself altering private legal rights.","evidence":"Director of the Office of Management and Budget, hereinafter referred to as the Director"},{"segment_id":"5","code":1,"rationale":"This is the beginning of an amendment deleting an earlier assignment of functions to the Secretary of Commerce; the completed action is an internal reassignment of executive responsibilities.","evidence":"Section 4 of Executive Order No. 11961, as amended, is further amended by deleting"},{"segment_id":"6","code":1,"rationale":"This quoted language identifies the administrative functions being removed from the Secretary of Commerce under the amendment; it does not independently impose a legal consequence.","evidence":"shall perform the functions set forth in Sections 4(a)(3) and 5(c) of the Act"},{"segment_id":"7","code":0,"rationale":"The substituted provision directs the Secretary of Commerce to make periodic reports to congressional committees, a reporting-to-Congress function expressly outside the legal-posture scope.","evidence":"making periodic reports to the Committees of the Congress"},{"segment_id":"8","code":1,"rationale":"The President immediately transfers agency records, property, personnel, and related appropriations balances to OMB as part of an internal executive reorganization.","evidence":"are hereby transferred to the Director of the Office of Management and Budget"},{"segment_id":"9","code":1,"rationale":"The OMB Director must implement the internal transfers, existing administrative instruments remain temporarily effective, and the order receives an effective date; these are implementation, continuity, and housekeeping provisions.","evidence":"take all steps necessary or appropriate to ensure or effectuate the transfers or reassignments provided by this Order"}]}
